note: Teen Titans voice lines. Segmented by silence (-38 dB, 0.35 s); Raven (MultiVersus, lines packed back to back) re-split at faster-whisper sentence word-timestamps. Transcribed offline (faster-whisper small.en). Left out: LEGO-Dimensions puzzle / level banter, lines naming characters from other franchises, and the YouTube channel tag every file opens with. A [a, b] entry = one clip spanning lines a..b (a two-part line).
